threads.name: The Influence of Francis Bartlett's Donations
threads.description: This theme explores how the donations from Francis Bartlett have significantly contributed to the museum's collection, highlighting the acquisition of key artifacts. The narrative begins with the purchase of a two-handled jar and a bronze statue in 1900, turns with the acquisition of a sarcophagus in 1912, and pays off by showcasing the lasting impact of these donations on the museum's historical and cultural offerings.

threads.name: The Museum's Evolution Through Construction and Expansion
threads.description: This theme traces the physical growth of the Museum of Fine Arts, Boston, through strategic construction projects. It starts with the museum's founding location at the Boston Athenæum in 1870, turns with the construction of a new wing along The Fens funded by Maria Antoi, and culminates in the continued expansion and modernization efforts that define the museum's current stature.

threads.name: The Role of Donors in Shaping the Collection
threads.description: This theme highlights the critical role of donors in enriching the museum's collection. It begins with the generous donation of the Wan-go H. C. Weng Collection in 2018, turns with John Goelet's donation of 'Maharana Sangram Singh Enjoys the Monsoon', and concludes with the impact of the Loïs Mailou Jones Pierre-Noël Trust's gift of 'Negro Student', illustrating how diverse donations have shaped the museum's offerings.
